info.title: AI Accounting Backend
info.description:
Bookcomet — AI-powered accounting platform for Hong Kong SMEs. Provides OCR document extraction, rule-based classification, OCR journals (draft), and AI chat assistance.

**Authentication:** Most endpoints require a `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header obtained from `POST /auth/login`, plus an `X-Company-ID` header.

**Rate limits:** AI endpoints are limited per company (see AbuseGuard env vars). With `REDIS_URL` set, limits and OCR concurrency are shared across all API instances. `POST /auth/login` and `POST /auth/register` are limited per IP.

post.description:
Create a local account (username + password; email optional).

When ``REGISTER_INVITE_CODE`` is set, ``invite_code`` must match (tunnel mode).
When unset, anyone on the reachable host may self-register (local PC default).
Authenticate with username or email; may return an MFA challenge.
Clear the refresh token cookie and invalidate the stored token.
Rotate the refresh token and issue a new access token.
Complete login after password + TOTP (SEC-CODE-009).
Start TOTP enrollment; scan otpauth_url, then POST /auth/mfa/enable.
Confirm TOTP enrollment with a valid code from the authenticator app.
Disable TOTP MFA (requires password + current code).
SEC-CODE-008: revoke refresh cookie and all outstanding access tokens.

post.description:
Route an OCR document to a new OTHER task.
1. Extract structured fields via LLM.
2. Create a new ChatTask with processing_mode="OTHER".
3. Create an OtherRecord with the extracted payload.
4. Auto-sync to formal tables.
5. Add an initial assistant message summarising what was extracted.
